title: Preregistered Volatility-Aware Position Sizing & Portfolio Risk Experiment Specification

prior_research_overlap.description: Candidate Alpha previously investigated inverse-volatility sizing using formula inv_vols[ticker] = 1.0 / max(v, 0.05) with position caps. Stage 2D formally isolates this sizing mechanism and tests pure (P1), capped-redistributed (P2), smoothed (P3), and blended (P4) variants under authentic corporate-action-adjusted simulation.

P1.name: Candidate P1: Pure Inverse Volatility
P1.capping_policy: Unconstrained allocation of base_budget across selected winners (no per-winner cap, standard agent._scale_caps applied only at portfolio level).

P2.name: Candidate P2: Capped Inverse Volatility with Capacity Redistribution
P2.formula: Starts with P1 weights. Assets exceeding max_position_cap (0.25) are clamped to 0.25; excess weight is iteratively redistributed to uncapped assets proportional to raw inverse volatility.
P2.redistribution: Deterministic proportional redistribution. If all assets reach capacity or no capacity remains, excess is retained as cash.

P3.name: Candidate P3: Smoothed Inverse Volatility
P3.formula: smoothed_vol_i = 0.5 * vol20_i(current) + 0.5 * vol20_i(previous_eligible); raw_w_i = 1.0 / max(smoothed_vol_i, 0.05). Capped and redistributed per P2.
P3.missing_prior_handling: If previous eligible decision date vol is None, smoothed_vol_i = vol20_i(current).

P4.name: Candidate P4: Equal / Inverse-Volatility Blend
P4.description: 50/50 convex combination of E0 equal sizing and P2 capped inverse-volatility sizing.
